settings.question: What is the return policy?
settings.answer: For health, safety and hygiene reasons, Pilo pillows can only be returned if they are unopened, unused and in their original sealed packaging.

settings.question: When will I get my order?
settings.answer: We dispatch within one business day. Delivery takes one to five days depending on where you are in Lebanon, and you get a message when it is on its way.

settings.question: How much does delivery cost?
settings.answer: Nothing. Delivery is free anywhere in Lebanon.

settings.question: Can I pay cash?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose cash on delivery at checkout and pay the courier when the pillow reaches you.

settings.question: What does OEKO-TEX® certified mean?
settings.answer: OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 is an independent certification for textiles. Every component of a certified item is laboratory tested against a long list of substances known to be harmful to human health — not only the main fabric, but the threads, the zip, and any coatings or prints.
